Emma (sales): Heads-up — MediWell wants SOC2 artifacts, an ISO scope summary, and a signed pen-test letter before we hand over a dedicated staging.
Raj (solutions): Can assemble a minimal pack: SOC2 attestation PDF, SOC2 control-map one-pager, ISO scope + exclusions summary, pen-test letter template, redacted network diagram, KMS attestation. Who owns final pen-test sign-off?
Olivia (eng-ops): I can provision staging once Legal confirms residency. For creds: ephemeral S3 presigned uploads + short-lived STS role. Need IP ranges to whitelist. @Mike can you confirm attestation wording and rotation windows?
Mike (security): Pen-test letter needs explicit scope (staging-only), allowed tests (no social engineering), target IP ranges, emergency pause contact, and signatory. We can provide vendor-signed PDF if required. For PHI push Private + customer KMS; if hosted staging, limit presigns and audit everything.
compliance-bot: SOC2 attestation available at /dataroom/soc2/Redwood_Soc2_Attestation_2025.pdf
Emma (sales): Procurement wants a ballpark for a 2-week reserved burst vs on-demand so they can pre-approve spend. A simple number is fine.
Raj (solutions): Heuristic: reserved commits give ~30% discount. For a short 2-week burst we quote a flat burst fee + prorated reserved credit. Need ops GPU-hour estimate.
Olivia (eng-ops): POC estimate: seq_len 1024, ~50 reqs/min peak, batching ~8, baseline ~12 GPU-hours/day. For 14 days with spikes, plan ~250 GPU-hours total.
Olivia (eng-ops): Quick calc:
```
baseline_daily_gpu_hours = 12
burst_factor = 1.6
gpu_rate_per_hour = $3.50
days = 14
total_hours = days * baseline_daily_gpu_hours * burst_factor  # ~269
total_cost = total_hours * gpu_rate_per_hour  # ~$940
```
Raj (solutions): Round infra to ~$1k for GPU runtime; add ops/support & presign handling — quote customer $1.4k–$1.8k as a conservative bundle.
Mike (security): Hosted staging constraints:
- presign expiry <= 24h (prefer 12h)
- ephemeral role rotation every 6h
- immutable audit logs for downloads
- redact internal hostnames on diagrams
- do not host PHI unless customer-managed KMS
Emma (sales): I'll draft the cover email and NDA request. Raj — can you drop the pen-test draft + SOC2 one-pager here when ready? I'll send the pack to MediWell by EOD.
Raj (solutions): Will upload drafts to dataroom and tag @Mike/@Olivia. Placeholder links: https://dataroom.redwood/internal/soc2-onepager.pdf and https://dataroom.redwood/drafts/pen-test-letter-v1.pdf
Olivia (eng-ops): Presign command I'll use for uploads:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-staging/mediwell/artifacts.zip --expires-in 86400
```
Also will enable lifecycle delete after 30 days and require an ops smoke test window.
Mike (security): I'll review the draft and add allowed test list + emergency pause contact. Also a 1-page redaction checklist.
Emma (sales): Thanks — plan: consolidate evidence pack + pricing note + staging runbook and send to MediWell by EOD. Ping here if Legal or Finance need in. :thumbsup:
